head: c1bcdd3209a6e6d120cae498d9902c77c7b0aba0
scope: Revise the draft and its planned validation for QG-1 through QG-4. No application implementation, installation, commit, or deployment performed.

resolutions.behavior: Zero-effect cancellation is limited to confirmation before dispatch. A lost or cancelled approval response remains unresolved until a same-id non-mutating receipt read returns a terminal outcome; no automatic approval retry is allowed.
resolutions.verification_planned: No POST before confirmation; delayed broker approval with response loss; same-id reconciliation; unresolved pending/missing/unavailable receipts; duplicate confirmation; bounded exit after dispatch.

resolutions.behavior: A five-second whole-read budget and asynchronous sequential storage traversal bound the new projection. Counts require a complete consistent scan independently of the list cap. Retained data excludes accumulated patch bodies; scan failure is unavailable, distinct from list overflow.
resolutions.verification_planned: More than 100 requests, multiple workspace/worktree targets, expired and terminal records, large valid patches, storage deadlines and cancellation, guard/handle release, bounded retained data, and no patches in summary/list responses.

resolutions.behavior: Counts stay in status refresh; foreground reads/actions share the existing guard. One invalidated prior refresh may overlap, cannot commit, and retires before completion refresh, preserving SPEC-003 sections 14.2-14.3.
resolutions.verification_planned: Delay counts, start approval immediately, complete approval before obsolete-read retirement, discard its late result, and start exactly one completion refresh after retirement.

resolutions.behavior: Patch content and filenames visibly escape terminal controls without stripping bytes or executing sequences. Display escapes preserve line/hunk structure, distinguish literal backslashes, and never replace the original broker patch or reviewed request id.
resolutions.verification_planned: Narrow/wide ESC/ANSI and control-character fixtures, literal escape-looking text, complete hunk navigation, unchanged stored patch bytes, and same-id approval.

validation.manual_contract_review: Passed: each original finding maps to behavior, acceptance criteria, and direct planned verification; canonical write ownership and the accepted refresh lifecycle remain intact.
validation.document_consistency: Passed: nine distinct acceptance criteria, removed conflicting cancellation/overlap wording, preserved draft execution boundary.
validation.preserved_inputs: SPEC-003, draft-validation.json, and the original quality-gate-review.json matched their pre-edit SHA-256 hashes.
validation.implementation_validation: Not run: build, typecheck, unit tests, and terminal/runtime acceptance remain future implementation checks.

limitations: This resolves plan findings only; the runtime read-cost opportunity remains unimplemented.
Original review evidence remains an immutable record of the previous document hash.
